title: [DocDB] ThreadSanitizer: data race in CompactionTestWithFileExpiration.FileExpirationAfterExpiry
body:
Jira Link: [DB-5417](https://yugabyte.atlassian.net/browse/DB-5417)
### Description

There are several Thread Sanitizer warnings in CompactionTestWithFileExpiration.FileExpirationAfterExpiry:
https://detective.dev.yugabyte.com/?commits=1979ca1dfc667a2a94e29b6ef6962cca8e3ed22b
